reference.pathophysiology: Threat circuitry (amygdala, insula) over detects danger while prefrontal regulation and safety learning lag; avoidance prevents extinction, maintaining disorders until exposure relearns safety.

Panic attack versus ACS or PE (medical exclusion by risk)
Social anxiety versus avoidant personality (episode versus lifelong pattern)
additionalInvestigations: Thyroid function, ECG and glucose when indicated
